annotations.text:
MEC Trading logo — six directions in the brand palette (gold on charcoal / ivory).

F — Illustrated horse mark (newest): a three-quarter horse head drawn in a bold illustrated style — layered mane locks, blaze down the face, pale muzzle, modelled in four tones of the brand gold. Original artwork, not traced from any reference. Full colour plus a one-colour silhouette for small sizes.

E — Sport horse mark: faceted profile head built from crisp straight planes.

A — Crest: chess-knight head in a double ring with the Fraunces italic wordmark.

B — Monogram: pure typography in a double lozenge. Restrained, but says luxury rather than horses.

C — Horseshoe: double-line shoe with nail holes and a star. Clear line of business, least ownable.

D — Western stable badge: an actual stable in a wood-type ranch stamp.

All vector; every element can be recoloured, retyped or exported on its own.
